description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different methods, comparing their performance across a range of AL values from 2.5 to 10.0. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", uses a linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5 units. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also uses a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33, with tick marks at intervals of 1 unit. The plot displays four distinct lines: the "Consistency-CE" method is represented by a purple line with circular markers and a dashed style, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 25.9 at AL=2.5 and rising to about 31.0 at AL=10.0; the "Inconsistency-CE" method is shown as a purple line with square markers and a dashed style, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 26.0 at AL=2.5 and increasing to about 31.2 at AL=10.0; the "Inconsistency-CE-MP" method is depicted by a blue line with square markers and a dashed style, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 26.2 at AL=2.5 and reaching about 31.8 at AL=10.0; and the "Consistency-Bi" method is shown as a red line with star markers and a solid style, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 29.0 at AL=2.5 and rising to about 32.2 at AL=10.0.
